name: Chaemin Jang
title: M.S. Student, KAIST School of Computing
lead: I study how language models produce their behavior, especially when outputs fall short of what they seem capable of.
bio: I’m an M.S. student at KAIST, co-advised by Jihee Kim and Dongman Lee.
home_description: M.S. student at KAIST School of Computing, researching LLM internals and simulation.
og_description: Research on knowledge, retrieval, and behavior in language models.
split: One line of my work asks when information recoverable from a model’s internal states shapes its answers, and how to help models use what they have learned more reliably. The other asks whether language models faithfully reproduce human behavior: the distribution of people’s opinions, and the ways they interact and change their minds.
